t: What Water Quality Evidence Database Is All About
title: What Water Quality Evidence Database Is All About
description: Water quality is measured parameters against standards: dissolved oxygen (>5 mg/L for fish), pH (6.5-8.5), turbidity, nitrates (<10 mg/L drinking), E. coli (zero tolerance in drinking water). The Clean Water Act (1972) cut US point-source pollution dramatically; Flint (2014) showed what happens when monitoring fails. Sample right — wrong bottles, bad timing, no chain of custody — and the numbers lie. This database is the complete water quality record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
